projectState.summary: Track D2b is approved by Claude and merged locally to main. Phrase candidate selection is now quality-driven: aggregateCandidateFitness uses prosody weights for kind:'phrase' or prosody-shaped score objects, D1 passes candidate.kind into aggregation, and provisional B4 rounded fitness is replaced by A2 aggregate fitness. Validation for the code branch was build green, db:smoke green, smoke 59/59. Next recommended work is D3: score developed children with scoreProsody -> aggregateCandidateFitness({ kind:'phrase' }) -> scoreCandidate, then run one or more deterministic generations so lineages compete and fitness improvement can be measured. Carry forward: fix branch-scoped candidate ids before parallel populations, handle rare no-op operator fallback, and later share/recompute B2 operators server-side before trusting operator provenance.
